simple.meaning: שָׁגַע (shâgaʻ) is a Hebrew action word meaning “to rave through insanity.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 7 times in Deuteronomy, 1 Samuel, 2 Kings, Jeremiah, Hosea, beginning at Deuteronomy 28:34. The surrounding contexts include priesthood, prophetic witness.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to שָׁגַע (H7696) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: שָׁגַע (shâgaʻ) / H7696 is traced through Deuteronomy 28:34, 1 Samuel 21:15, 1 Samuel 21:16, 2 Kings 9:11 with source-language evidence and verse context.

definitions.full: H7696. shaga [ שָׁגַע ] Pu`al be mad (Arabic coo, of male pigeon, utter long whinny , of camel (compare Hoffm ZAW iii (1883), 89 RS JPhil. Xiv. 119 f. Goldziher Arab. Philol. i. 59 ff. Lag BN 202 ); Ethiopic be mad ( n insert, Di 1055 Ba ES 50 ); Assyrian šegû, rage, howl; on meaning in Hebrew see especially We Skizzen iii. 130 ); — Pu`al Participle as adjective : predicate מְשֻׁגָּע וְהָיִיתָ Deut 28:34 thou shalt be maddened ( מִן because of), figurative for driven to despair; ׳מ of prophets, contemptuously Hosea 9:7 , וּמִתְנַבֵּא מ ׳כָּלאִֿישׁ Jer 29:26 , as substantive 2Kin 9:11 ; plural מְשֻׁגָּעִים 1 Samuel 21:16 madmen . Hithpa`el shew madness; Participle מִשְׁתַּגֵּעַ אִישׁ 1Sam 21:15 ; Infinitive construct לְהִשְׁתַּגֵּעַ v.1 Samuel 21:16.

occurrences.englishText: so that the sights that you see with your eyes will drive you mad.
Do I lack madmen, that you have brought this fellow to play the madman in my presence? Should this fellow come into my house?”
When Jehu came out to the servants of his lord, and one said to him, “Is all well? Why did this mad fellow come to you?”

“Yahweh has made you priest in the place of Jehoiada the priest, that there may be officers in Yahweh’s house, for every man who is crazy, and makes himself a prophet, that you should put him in the stocks and in shackles.
The days of visitation have come.
